meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 遇到页面或界面设计时,Claude 会先写一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范(颜色、字体、间距等)再动手写页面;之后用真实浏览器检查速度和可访问性,并对照参考图验收。
howto.when: 当提到「前端」「UI」「设计」等关键词,或要求做 React、改版、性能审计时触发。

say.text: 把这三张截图做成一套可复用的 React 组件
say.note: 会先写入 DESIGN.md 设计规范再实现

say.text: 把这个页面改成 Linear 风格,简约高级一点
say.note: 会加载 Linear 的设计系统再按它重做

say.text: 用真实浏览器跑一次性能审计,看哪里拖慢了
say.note: 会按移动端和桌面端各测几次取中位数再给诊断

howto.what_en: For UI work Claude first writes a DESIGN.md design spec (colors, type, spacing), then builds the page against it. It finishes by auditing speed and accessibility in a real browser and comparing the result against any reference images.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'frontend', 'UI', or 'design', or ask to redesign a page, build in React, or audit performance.

say_en.text: Turn these three screenshots into a reusable set of React components.
say_en.note: It writes a DESIGN.md spec first, then builds reusable primitives.

say_en.text: Make this page feel minimal and refined, like Linear.
say_en.note: It loads Linear's design system and restyles to match.

say_en.text: Run a real-browser performance audit and show me what's slow.
say_en.note: It tests mobile and desktop presets and reports the median.
